item.title: Bulletin updated at 02:50 HKT 01/Mar/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A warm and humid maritime airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. There will be damp days over the region. The weather will be foggy in the morning and at night. A cold front is expected to move across Guangdong on Tuesday. There will be showers and thunderstorms over the region. Under the influence of the associated northeast monsoon and its replenishment, temperatures will fall progressively over the region in the middle and latter parts of next week. The weather will be appreciably cooler with a few rain patches.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches and coastal mist in the morning and at night. Rather warm with sunny periods during the day.
Temp range: 20 - 25 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
